regime.verdict_text: PM7 thesis intact — Council CONFIRMED. Jun 5 global risk-off driven primarily by +93k prior-month revisions (not seasonal May headline) + AI/chip de-rating + SpaceX liquidity test. May NFP: 73% of beat from leisure/hospitality (+70k, pre-summer seasonal) + local gov (+55k, timing); private cyclicals showed zero acceleration. Hawkish read stands because revisions are least-contestable. Regime: Orange. Action wk Jun 9: hold PM7 positioning, no cyclicals into strength, keep cash dry for DXY pullback absorption. Next gating event: US CPI print.
